sentences.en: The civilian unrest is showing no signs of abating.
sentences.zh: 民众骚动没有减弱的迹象。

sentences.en: My anger has abated already. However, I will resign.
sentences.zh: 我的愤怒已经平息了。不过，我将会辞职。

sentences.en: This action would not have been sufficient to abate the odor nuisance.
sentences.zh: 这项行动不足以减轻臭味的困扰。
